mentions.name: Ragextract
mentions.description: This AI tool processes documents and extracts their content into organized rows in a fully featured AI table/datagrid, relaunched from an earlier document processing and RAG API. It aims to be a low-friction AI utility, avoiding the gating, sales meetings, and subscriptions of big-name document-first AI table products.
mentions.problem: Document-first AI tables are gated behind a few big names, a sales meeting, or another subscription.
mentions.audience: Anyone working with a lot of documents who needs their extraction organized into rows; particularly people considering leaving Airtable.
mentions.source_excerpt: Relaunched https://ragextract.com over the past month - from document processing and RAG API to fully featured AI table/datagrid.
